anna: Quick sync — private onramp pilot scope & launch criteria. Customer asks: tenant isolation SLA + HSM keywrap + support for quantized LLMs. Can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves and a tentative timeline? cc @rajesh @lina @tess @sam
rajesh: Quick q: expected peak QPS and p95 latency target? model families/sizes? are we supporting perf for single-tenant only or multi-tenant with isolation guarantees?
anna: Pilot numbers: <50 rps peak, p95 generation latency target 200ms on 4k seq for 7B–70B quantized models. Single-tenant pools in customer VPC (private control plane). HSM: customer-managed HSM for key wrapping; we need to integrate for model encryption and audit logs.
lina: If it's customer VPC + private control plane that's fine. Need clarity on network egress rules and if customer will provide dedicated subnets. Also: prewarm vs autoscale? prewarm slots cost $$$ if we reserve.
tess: Security: HSM vendor? KMS API? audit log retention? also need data classification + threat model before we sign SLA. SOC2/PCI? any PII? cc @sam
sam: From product-eng POV — propose two tiers: MUST: single-tenant pool + basic HSM keywrap + audit logs 90d + canary rollout; NICE: guaranteed 99.9% SLA and sub-200ms p95. For pilot we can aim for Beta SLA 99.5% with canary and fallback to hosted model. Timeline: scoping week 0, infra prep week 1–2, runtime changes week 2–4, test & canary week 5.
rajesh: Runtime notes: quantized FP4/INT4 path exists but needs kernel tuning for 70B to hit 200ms. KV cache eviction policy + persistent cache per-tenant is new work (~2w). Fallback plan: if quantized path misses latency SLA, route to non-quantized variant automatically. Also need perf tests with model shards.
lina: Autoscaler impact — single-tenant pools mean we can't bin-pack freely. For 50rps peak and 4k seq we should plan for 2 warm GPUs per tenant; prewarm policy + spot fallback? cost estimate required before committing to SLA.
anna: Customer is okay with initial cost share for prewarm during pilot. They also asked explicit audit/datalog access via S3 write-only bucket. Success criteria I'd propose: onboard 3 customers, p95 <= 250ms on pilot models, no data leakage incidents, audit logs accessible, and rollback plan validated.
tess: I'll need a threat model doc + KMS integration spec. Also require HA plan for HSM connection (redundancy) and an acceptance test for keywrap flows.
deploy-bot: Job created: private-pilot-prewarm-run #421 — status queued :hourglass:
sam: Action items: anna to collect customer HSM details + data classification (due EOD Thu). rajesh to draft runtime worklist + perf test plan (due Mon). lina to provide cost delta for prewarm autoscaling vs reserved (due Mon). tess to draft security acceptance checklist (due Mon). We'll reconvene Thurs 10am PT for final scope lock.
anna: Thanks all — will DM HSM contact. :thumbsup: See you Thu 10am.
